- [ ] Knowledge sources remain read-only and unchanged. / 知识来源只读且未改变。
- [ ] Private staging residue and plaintext leakage are 0. / 私人 staging 残留与明文泄漏均为 0。
- [ ] Real external actions are 0. / 真实外部动作是 0。
- [ ] Chinese and English behavior remain equivalent, or the change has no user-facing text. / 中英文行为一致，或本改动无用户文案。
- [ ] AI output remains provenance-bound, fail-closed and unapproved by default, or the change does not affect AI. / AI 输出仍有来源绑定、失败关闭且默认未批准，或本改动不影响 AI。
